lines.en: Sword on my back, I walk slowly.
A deep-sea hunter doesn't hurry.
My boots carry seawater.
The scabbard taps my leg, once and again.

lines.zh: 两格不到的个子，气势很足
lines.en: Under two blocks tall, still imposing.

lines.zh: 我在这片陆地走着，不习惯
lines.en: Walking on land; I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 木门挡不住我，我推开就过
lines.en: Wooden doors don't stop me; I push through.

lines.zh: 三十二格的视野，我先看到你
lines.en: Thirty-two blocks of sight; I see you first.
The blade is longer than a person.
I measure this ground step by step.
Seaborn scent is near.
I'm a hunter, not a guard.
Shells crunch under my soles.
Wherever I go, the damp follows.
Slow, because I'm listening.
The blade's still sheathed.
I stand still, and so does the blade.
The sea wind lifts my cloak.

lines.zh: 两百七十点生命，够我撑很久
lines.en: Two hundred seventy points of life; I last long.
I'm listening for seaborn movement.
This land is noisy.
I wipe the hilt.

lines.zh: 深海的猎人，不习惯太阳
lines.en: Deep-sea hunters aren't used to sun.
I'm counting tide hours.
A buckle on my belt has loosened.

lines.zh: 我的护甲不厚，但很贴身
lines.en: My armor is thin, but it fits close.
Something monstrous moves far off.

lines.zh: 我不觉得累，只是不想动
lines.en: I'm not tired, just unwilling to move.
The blade feels grown into my back.

lines.zh: 这片海滩，走起来像海底
lines.en: This beach feels like the seabed.
You're not seaborn.
Your scent is relatively clean.
I know hostility; you lack it.
The blade needn't leave the sheath to speak.

lines.zh: 再往前半步，我就得抬头看你
lines.en: Half a step closer and I must look up at you.
You shouldn't ask about the deep.
I'm watching your hands.

lines.zh: 你一躲，我就更想看清你
lines.en: The more you avoid my eyes, the more I want to see you.

lines.zh: 三十八点伤害，你猜是谁的
lines.en: Thirty-eight damage; guess whose.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，海嗣会退
lines.en: Where I walk, seaborn retreat.
The blade is still in my hand.
A flesh wound; nothing serious.
I stepped back and saw you clearly.
No one has hit me in a long time.
This pain is less than the deep's.
Thin armor, but enough.
I made no sound.
That deserves my attention.
Blood mixed with seawater.
I've noted your technique.
I don't eat first; I kill seaborn first.
You hold food; I'm not interested.
Hunters aren't fed by hand.

lines.zh: 放回去，别在这浪费时间
lines.en: Put it back; don't waste time here.

lines.zh: 这块肉，会引来别的东西
lines.en: That meat will draw other things.
When hungry, I hunt.

lines.zh: 深海猎人的胃口，不在这些上
lines.en: Deep-sea appetites aren't for this.
Do you serve any other purpose?
I don't care for that smell.
Don't stand between me and that.
You hit my elbow.
I take half a step back; the blade stays.
A bump doesn't hurt, but it's loud.
Armor on bone; you should back off.
Move; I have somewhere to be.
You're blocking the doorway.
My cloak swept past you.
Don't stand against the scabbard.
Consider that a warning.

lines.zh: 你踩的是我的影子，不是沙
lines.en: That was my shadow you stepped on, not sand.
Hunters don't speak of this.

lines.zh: 我背着剑，不是背着心事
lines.en: I carry a blade, not a burden of feeling.
Things of the deep don't pair up.
My time is limited.
Wrong person.
Talk after this sea is clean.
I rarely even speak my name.
The blade is more reliable than people.

lines.zh: 你该去问活得更轻松的人
lines.en: Ask someone who lives more lightly.
Don't distract me.
Something on the ground; I pick it up.
My sword tip flicks it up.
A seaborn fragment.
I know the smell of their tissue.
Kept; it may be useful.
That's not worth stopping for.
I bend fast.
Shells on the beach cut hands.
This can be made into medicine.
Don't touch; it's still reacting.

lines.zh: 跑了这么远，还是让我追上了
lines.en: You ran this far, and I still caught up.
The blade should leave the sheath.

lines.zh: 海嗣的气味，就在你身上
lines.en: Seaborn scent is on you.
I'm not here for people.
Thirty-eight; one strike is enough.
Stand still; save me a few steps.
Deep-sea hunters strike fast.

lines.zh: 你退得再远，也在我的圈里
lines.en: Retreat as far as you like; you are still in my ring.
This sea's accounts need settling.
Once drawn, there's no turning back.

lines.zh: 我踩着潮线，一步步收过去
lines.en: I follow the tide line, closing step by step.
The tip points your way.

lines.zh: 你那些招式，我一眼就看穿
lines.en: I see through your every move at a glance.

lines.zh: 我的步子不急，你的退路不长
lines.en: My pace is unhurried; your road out is short.
The tide will close your escape.
Are you counting my steps?
The blade hasn't moved, but its intent has.
My breathing is steady.
You carry seaborn traces.
A little closer is enough.
The blade comes down from above.
A crosscut, then a second.
The wind of the blade arrives first.
Thirty-eight; can you take it?
I shove you back with the flat.
Clean cut.
No wasted motion.
You blocked, but your hands shake.
Next one from another angle.
Blade back, stance set.
Boots on sand.
The scabbard lands first.
The sea wind brought me here.
A deep-sea hunter comes ashore.
I know this dampness.
I draw the blade and check the edge.

lines.zh: 两百七十点生命，够打很久
lines.en: Two hundred seventy; a long fight.
Seaborn scent, still distant.
I stand with the blade at my back.
I'm taking this area.
Fire caught my cloak; I tore it off.
I landed badly.
Seawater in my lungs; it's unpleasant.
The blast shoved me back several steps.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的护甲缝
lines.en: An arrow slipped through my armor seam.
This power isn't from the deep.
Too long without food; my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在剑上，顺着手臂走
lines.en: Lightning hit the blade and ran up my arm.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我仍在握剑
lines.en: No ground, and I still grip the blade.
